verdict.rationale: Field extraction is a fair question for a browser automation platform, but no evidence item documents CSS or XPath selector rules for pulling specific fields. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: natural-language selectors in the SDK (docs-5), URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown conversion (docs-3), and generic full browser control (docs-4).

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules
